corrections.issue: The initial summary treated a missing previous valid checkpoint as zero plateau change.
corrections.resolution: A preferred peak now requires all three bracket samples to have previous valid checkpoints and the latest uncontaminated peak to pass the 0.5% plateau criterion.
corrections.effect: All ten frozen BW calibration peak locations and shares are unchanged. As-like N=4 no longer has an accepted plateau and requires a length extension. The earliest-checkpoint sensitivity diagnostic inside frozen training_fit.json was permissive and is superseded by final diagnostics; coefficients and heldout predictions remain frozen.
corrections.subsequent_resolution: The frozen-policy As-like N=4 length extension completed at zN=8. All three bracket samples now have valid prior checkpoints and pass the plateau criterion; its preferred peak is included in the final tables. The original frozen BW coefficients remain unchanged.

corrections.issue: The first time-domain HC kernel check used an integer temporary array at dt=3 fs and stopped with a casting error.
corrections.resolution: Use explicit floating-point arrays; rerun completed. Initial failure log is retained as raw overlap_and_kernel.log; successful retry is kernel_validation_retry.log.

corrections.issue: Checked whether the tiny-frequency HC first-moment estimate suffered cancellation, because it differed slightly from a prior discretized-kernel moment.
corrections.resolution: Independent time-domain adaptive quadrature confirms the tiny-frequency estimate (2.463955525 fs) to the reported quadrature precision. No cancellation discrepancy was found; the earlier 2.464016493 fs reference is a discretized-kernel approximation. The original overlap output and raw log are preserved; overlap maxima are unchanged.
